STK39 in TCGA colorectal cancer (COAD + READ): expression, co-expression programs and survival

2026-10-17

Data

UCSC Xena GDC hub (STAR gene counts, log2(count+1), back-transformed to counts; GDC clinical and OS tables). One primary tumor (-01) and/or one solid tissue normal (-11) sample per patient: 624 tumors, 51 normals. Expression = TMM-normalised log2 CPM.

1. Tumor vs normal

Median STK39 log2CPM: tumor 6.29 vs normal 6.41; Wilcoxon p = 0.17. In 50 matched pairs the median tumor−normal difference was -0.0901 (paired Wilcoxon p = 0.0968; 54% of pairs lower in tumor). No significant tumor/normal difference.

2. STK39-high vs STK39-low tumors (median split, limma-voom, adjusted for COAD/READ)

15805 protein-coding genes tested; 11012 had FDR < 0.05 (large n gives power for small shifts), but only 3 up / 130 down passed FDR < 0.05 & |log2FC| > 1. Top down: LTC4S, TMEM121, MRPS24, MMP23B, GPS2, HDAC10, CCR10, CASTOR1, CAVIN3, FTH1. Up: ARHGEF35, EIF3CL, CLDN2.

3. Enrichment

ORA (|log2FC|>1 genes): GO BP down = 0 terms, KEGG down = 2 (Nicotine addiction; Neuroactive ligand-receptor interaction); too few up genes for ORA. GSEA on the limma t-statistic: 591 GO BP (349 positive / 242 negative) and 65 KEGG pathways at FDR<0.05. STK39-high tumors are enriched for RNA processing, spliceosome, ER protein processing and cell cycle; STK39-low tumors for immune/inflammatory and neuroactive-ligand programs.

4. Survival (overall survival)

n = 591, 122 deaths. Log-rank (median split) p = 0.441.

Cox models (continuous = per 1 SD of log2CPM; multivariable adjusts for age, sex, stage I–II vs III–IV, COAD/READ)
Model HR CI p n events
univariate_continuous univariate_continuous 0.941 0.784–1.13 0.511 591 122
univariate_high_vs_low univariate_high_vs_low 0.870 0.61–1.24 0.441 591 122
multivariable_continuous multivariable_continuous 0.883 0.737–1.06 0.174 571 113

STK39 was not associated with OS (proportional-hazards assumption not violated, global Schoenfeld p = 0.43). Age and stage III–IV were strong predictors, as expected.

Limitations

Only 51 normal samples (50 matched pairs); bulk RNA-seq is confounded by tumor purity and stromal/immune content, which likely drives much of the high-vs-low signal (immune programs in STK39-low); median split is arbitrary; OS has limited events and TCGA follow-up is short; no external validation cohort; associations are correlative only.
